me.about:
Bachelor's and Licentiate's degrees in Biological Sciences from the University of São Paulo and an MBA specialization in Data Science & Analytics. I have years of experience working as a science teacher and lab technician in a Geology and Paleontology Laboratory, where I developed my first project in the construction of an educational portal with WordPress, where I had contact with Web Design, SEO, and Google Analytics, where my interest in Development was awakened and where I have focused my studies and projects. 
I am currently looking to migrate my career to ​front-end development. I have studied and worked on projects using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, ReactJS, NextJs, Git, GitHub, and SQL.
